summary: Iteration 3 backend testing for Online Vaidhyaji AYUSH — admin panel + doctor approval + support/lead-gen chatbot + activity log. Added /app/backend/tests/test_admin_support.py with 20 new tests. Full regression: 58/58 tests pass (20 new + 38 existing). Fixed 2 real backend bugs during testing: (a) POST /api/support/chat returned 422 because signature had `user: Optional[dict] = None` which FastAPI treated as a required body field — removed the unused param; (b) all seeded doctors in DB were stored without the `verified` field (schema evolved after seed ran), which made public GET /api/doctors return an EMPTY list — added a startup backfill that sets verified=True for pre-existing seed docs (verified missing OR null && no user_id). Both fixes are minimal and required for the requested spec to work at all.

minor.issue: `consultations_today` is computed via string comparison on ISO datetime string (`created_at >= today-midnight.isoformat()`). Works because ISO format is lexicographically sortable, but a real timestamp/date column is safer.
DoctorUpsertInput defaults `verified=True` — admin-created doctors go LIVE immediately (intentional?). If the intent is 'admin should also approve', flip default to False.
Sets user.verified=True on the linked user but does NOT flip user.role from 'doctor' (already doctor) or any other capability — just informational. No functional issue.
Rate-limiting / abuse control is absent on the anonymous LLM endpoint. A public LLM endpoint with no auth can be spammed and burn Emergent LLM quota. Consider IP-based or session-based throttling.
No validation that `contact` is a real phone/email. Accepts any string. Add regex/EmailStr union validation.
Sorted by ISO string `at`. Same note as consultations_today.

action_items: Review the two backend fixes I applied (server.py): (1) removed unused `user: Optional[dict] = None` from POST /api/support/chat so anonymous body-only requests work, (2) added a one-time startup backfill setting verified=True on seed doctors missing the field. Both are small and safe.

Decide the intent for POST /api/admin/doctors — should admin-created doctors default to `verified=False` (require an explicit approve step) or True (as today)? Currently the spec says approve/reject should flip verified, which does work, but new admin-created doctors bypass approval.
Add rate-limiting to the anonymous /api/support/chat endpoint.
Add lightweight validation on lead.contact (email OR phone regex).
Consider storing timestamps as native datetime (BSON Date) rather than ISO strings for `created_at` and `at` — string comparison works today but is fragile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 890 lines — approaching the 700-line refactor threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/: auth.py, admin.py, doctors.py, appointments.py, chat.py, support.py, reports.py, reminders.py.
log_activity is fire-and-forget with a bare try/except that swallows all errors — good for resilience, but consider structured logging on failure so silent activity log drops are visible.
Doctor approval mutates two collections (doctors + users) without a transaction. If the second update fails, state is inconsistent. Motor supports transactions on replica sets; consider wrapping.

SUPPORT_PROMPT depends on the LLM emitting the exact string 'LEAD_CAPTURED' at the end. This is a fragile contract — model may drop the marker on some phrasing. Consider a second deterministic pass (regex for name+phone/email) to set lead_captured in the response, independent of the model.
admin_stats performs 8 sequential count_documents queries — could be parallelised with asyncio.gather for lower latency (minor).
Public /api/doctors filters on `verified: True` (good). But there is no server-side pagination — a large doctor list will grow unbounded (`to_list(200)` cap only).

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 — POST /api/support/chat 422: endpoint signature was `async def support_chat(body: SupportChatInput, user: Optional[dict] = None)`. FastAPI treats non-primitive param `user` as an additional body field, so it wrapped the request as `{body: {...}, user: {...}}` and rejected a bare `{session_id, message}` body with 422 'Field required loc=[body,body]'. Fix: removed the unused `user` param. Bug 2 — Public /api/doctors returned empty: seed only runs when `db.doctors.count_documents({}) == 0`. On an environment seeded before the `verified` field existed, the seed doctors were stored without that field and never re-touched. The public list query is `{verified: True}`, which excludes them all. Fix: on startup, update_many `{verified: {$exists: False}} -> {$set: {verified: True}}` and `{verified: null, user_id: {$exists: False}} -> {$set: {verified: True}}` (targets seed doctors only, not self-registered pending doctors which have a user_id).
